title: Bound the #7131 two-blocker scalar search (0% κ change)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

This research package exhausts two fixed two-blocker searches on the #7131 paid scalar profile. The independent-cut search tested 73,461 complete paid placements. The support-aware overlap search tested all eight eligible placements. Neither search yielded a positive certified price, and zero cases remain unresolved in those two scopes. Three or more blockers and different provider, caller, or support contracts remain open.

**NO VERIFIED GAIN.** The comparator is #7131 at `67a6544cf18b2d372fd1d0deee1863e9f6ca9fc5`, with κ = 0.003642408496869. Δκ = 0 and the relative change is 0%.

## Replay

From the PR checkout with CPython 3.12:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-two-blocker-exclusion
```

The clean package replay, registered replay, and committed-byte checks passed locally on CPython 3.12.14. The package includes the exact source references, pinned inputs, all-term journal, verification receipts, and scope limits. The replay verifies both distinct `two_blockers.py` files by path and rejects duplicate receipt keys. It needs no prior checkout, temporary pointer, or network fetch.

## Credit

Dillona’s #7130 and pinned same-word source supplied the inherited scalar inputs. #6290 is the closest distinct fixed-route search identified in the overlap check. This contribution supplies the two exhaustive scoped replays and portable package. Codex and its subagents materially assisted the search, verification, and packaging.
